title: Rights and powers; supplemental.
bodyText: The rights and powers conferred upon the authority by this subpart shall be in addition and supplemental to the rights and powers conferred upon the authority by any other law.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: This section was renumbered from §356D-70 pursuant to §23G-15.

bodyHtml:
[§356D-60]  Rights and powers; supplemental.  The rights and powers conferred upon the authority by this subpart shall be in addition and supplemental to the rights and powers conferred upon the authority by any other law. [L 2006, c 180, pt of §2]

 

Revision Note

 

  This section was renumbered from §356D-70 pursuant to §23G-15.
